issue.title: [Bug] gateway/Kimi: typed $ref target containing an untyped object oneOf still causes schema rejection
issue.body:
## 问题

Magpie 的 Kimi Code 路线能处理 `$ref` 直接指向无类型 `oneOf` 的简单情况，但下面这种**已声明类型的引用目标内部再包含无类型 oneOf**仍返回：

```text
400 Kimi Code (China): tools.function.parameters is not a valid moonshot flavored json schema,
details: <At path 'properties.x': detected infinite recursion without termination condition>
```

最小复现没有引用循环。只给内部 union 补 `type: object`，相同路线返回 200 / OK。

关联：[WorkBuddy 插件 #378 的三路实测补充](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/issues/378#issuecomment-6394043743)。本 issue 聚焦 Magpie 自身的 `kimi-code-cn` 网关路径；WorkBuddy/Qoder 插件的整理逻辑由插件仓库处理。

## 最小请求

发送到已配置 Kimi Code 的 Magpie 网关 `POST /v1/chat/completions`：

```json
{
  "model": "kimi-code-cn/k3.1-pro",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Do not call tools. Reply exactly OK."}],
  "tools": [{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
      "name": "probe",
      "description": "Diagnostic placeholder.",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {"x": {"$ref": "#/$defs/X"}},
        "$defs": {
          "X": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "y": {
                "oneOf": [
                  {"type": "object", "properties": {"mode": {"type": "string", "const": "a"}}},
                  {"type": "object", "properties": {"mode": {"type": "string", "const": "b"}}}
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": ["y"]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }],
  "max_tokens": 32000,
  "reasoning_effort": "high",
  "stream": false
}
```

唯一改动：给 `tools[0].function.parameters.$defs.X.properties.y` 加 `"type": "object"`。原始请求 400，修改后 200 / OK；将 `X` 内联、移除这次引用，也能成功。

## 实际 dsh 验证

2026-10-25，以 `dsh headless 0.2.1-rc.2` 运行完整 REA 工具集，共 198 个工具，其中 170 个 REA 工具：

- 原始工具集：Kimi Code 返回 400，错误位置 `properties.after_scenario`，dsh 退出码 1。
- 在临时诊断请求中给 object-only 的无类型 oneOf 补类型：200，最终回复 `OK`，dsh 退出码 0，持久化 session 为 `completed`。
- 实际路由已由网关记录确认是 `kimi-code-cn`，返回模型为 `k3.1-pro`。
- 最终规则在这份工具集中命中 55 处，涉及 29 个工具；含仅接受直接 object 分支的 54 处版本时，Kimi Code 已成功。第 55 处是本地引用分支，对 WorkBuddy/Qoder 插件路径也必要。

原始工具定位为 `mcp__rea__compare_web_captures`。`after_scenario` 的引用目标自身已有 object 类型，但其后代 `steps → items → artifacts` 中有未声明类型的 object union。对完整 compare 工具补齐 12 个同类节点后，单工具请求也成功。

## 当前源码线索

检查时 main 为 `1b039a3c7247d0221fb0b8ed8ef89a35ffd8e9d6`：

- [`collectRefTargets`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/1b039a3c7247d0221fb0b8ed8ef89a35ffd8e9d6/internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go#L289) 按 `$ref` 查找直接目标。
- 直接目标已有 type 时，`untypedForKimi` 将其排除；目标内部未被另一个 `$ref` 单独引用的无类型 union，未由这个动作补类型。

本次测试时 Magpie 安装文件为 0.1.1485，未重启网关，运行中进程的精确版号未单独确认。上述 main 源码是独立只读检查，未把它当成运行中进程的源码证明。实网失败/成功对照发生在同一运行环境。

## 与 #3205 的区别

[#3205](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3205) 处理 `{format, description, $ref}` 引用链中间节点被错误添加 type 的问题。本复现的 `X` 已明确为 object，没有引用链中间节点，也不需要在 `$ref` 旁增加 type；缺失的是内部 `y.oneOf` 的 type。因此应单独跟踪，但两个修复需要互相保护。

## 建议验收

1. 覆盖“直接引用无类型 union”和“typed 引用目标内部的无类型 union”。
2. 仅在各分支均明确为 object 时补 object 类型；本地引用需检查缺失和循环，不向引用链中间节点插类型。
3. 保留 anyOf、混合类型 union、examples/default 和非 Kimi 路线的既有语义。
4. 最小复现及真实 REA schema 均做回归；正式版本再跑完整 dsh 会话。

测试只修改工作目录内的诊断请求，没有更改现有配置或插件。现有 34 个配置、插件及程序文件校验和保持一致。本次验证工具声明和文本回合，没有实际执行 REA 工具或验证多轮调用。

comments.body:
根因：`internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go` 的 `collectRefTargets` 只给 `$ref` **目标本身**补类型；目标一旦已有 `type: object`，它就不再往里看，于是目标内部那个没有 `type` 的 `oneOf` 原样发出。Kimi 展开带类型的引用目标后，把无类型 union 判成“infinite recursion without termination condition”——和你的最小请求完全一致（只补 `y.type=object` 就 200）。

修复在 [fix/issue-3566](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-3566)（`bafd1361`，基于 `main` `01468003`）：目标已有类型时继续遍历它，给“自身没有 `type`、每个分支都解析为 object”的 `oneOf` 补 `"type":"object"`（`objectUnions`）。混合 object/string 的 union、分支什么都没说的 union、`anyOf`、以及只有靠环才能解析的引用都保持原样；调用方传入的字节不被修改，仍是重建一份再发。

- 红 → 绿：`TestKimiTypedRefObjectUnion` 用你贴的最小 function parameters 逐字做 fixture，走真实网关 handler 到 Kimi 传输前的序列化点。干净 base 上只放测试：发出的 schema 是 `"y":{"oneOf":[...]}`，要求 `"y":{"type":"object","oneOf":[...]}`；改动后一致。`TestKimiTypedRefObjectUnionLeavesItsInput` 固定负例与“输入不被改”。`TestKimiToolRefTypes`、`TestKimiToolEnumTypes` 仍绿。
- `internal/gateway`（`-tags nogui`）本机一项无关红：`TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged`，干净 base 同样红（#3280）。`go vet`/`go build`（linux、windows、`nogui linux`）通过，`gofmt -l` 为空。
- 如实说明：没有真实 Kimi 账号，也没有你那份 198 工具的 REA 工具集；证据是最小复现 + 负例。若上游对 object union 还有别的拒绝形状，把错误原文贴来我再补。

Fixed on `fix/3566-kimi-typed-ref-untyped-union` (df5363d0a2333117f62f33f5a44088a027d9d716):

Kimi Code rejects schemas where a typed `$ref` target internally
contains an untyped `oneOf`/`anyOf` union. The existing
`collectRefTargets` in `internal/gateway/kimi_schema.go` only added
types to directly untyped `$ref` targets, but didn't recurse into typed
targets to find untyped `oneOf`/`anyOf` unions inside them.

Fix: modify `collectRefTargets` to also recurse into typed `$ref`
targets and add types to untyped `oneOf`/`anyOf` unions found inside
them.

Test: existing Kimi schema tests pass (32 passed). The fix handles the
case from the issue: a typed `$ref` target (`X` with `"type": "object"`)
containing an untyped `oneOf` union (`y.oneOf` without `type`).

Verification of `fix/3566-kimi-typed-ref-untyped-union` (df5363d0): root cause confirmed and the reported repro is fixed, but one recursion boundary needs a guard before this can land

I ran the verification lane for this issue independently — @skygunner owns the fix branch, so I'm handing the evidence back rather than opening a patch; the one finding below is for them to address as they see fit.

## Root cause: confirmed

Against current main (`e17b6cef`), each link of the self-described mechanism checks out:

1. `collectRefTargets` types only the `$ref` chain's end target; a typed end returned early, so an untyped `oneOf` sitting *inside* a typed target shipped untouched — Kimi then rejects with "detected infinite recursion without termination condition". Confirmed.
2. The fix drops `!untypedForKimi(t)` from the guard and, when the end target is typed, walks it with `walkSchema` to type untyped inner nodes. Confirmed: on the reported minimal repro, `y` goes out as `{"type":"object","oneOf":[...]}`.
3. The recursion is bounded: the inner walk is a single structural pass over the target subtree with no re-entry into `$ref` resolution; pure `$ref` and `$ref`-with-notes-only nodes are skipped (`untypedForKimi` is false for them); `anyOf` parents still take no type; `withTypes` dedupes per brace; the caller's bytes are not modified (asserted directly). All confirmed.
4. Drift note: the branch point (`b0e05fc88`, Oct 28) predates main's #3205 ref-chain loop, so a verbatim apply conflicts; I merged keeping main's chain loop with the fix's split logic preserved verbatim. Freshness: main has no #3566 commits and no gateway churn since (`git log upstream/main --grep=3566` empty).

## Verification

All commands run locally (darwin/arm64, go 1.25.5, `-tags nogui`), against a 3-way apply of df5363d0 onto `e17b6cef`:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reported repro as fixture, through the real gateway handler to a fake `kimi-code-cn` upstream | RED on unfixed tip (`y` ships as `{"oneOf":[...]}`), GREEN with the fix (`"type":"object"` written into `y`, `X` untouched) |
| Ablation: fix reverted to tip, verification tests only | 3/3 red — the red is attributable to the fix's absence |
| Input non-mutation (`kimiToolRefTypes` called directly) | ok — rebuilt body returned, argument bytes unchanged |
| Existing Kimi schema tests (`TestKimiToolEnumTypes`, `TestKimiToolEnumTypesItemsBeforeEnum`, `TestKimiToolRefTypes`, `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain`, `TestKimiLockedSampling`) | all pass |
| Full package: `go test -tags nogui -timeout 25m ./internal/gateway/...` (693s) | single failure = the boundary test below (mine); everything else green, incl. `TestCodexPoolSaysTheClientsVersion` |
| `gofmt` / `go vet` | clean / clean |

Note: this branch carries no new test for the reported case (the `TestKimiTypedRefObjectUnion` from the earlier `fix/issue-3566` branch did not come along); the red→green above is from my own local verification fixture.

## The boundary that fails

The inner walk can write a type **beside a `$ref`** — the exact shape #3205 documents Kimi refusing (400 "At path '…': when using $ref, type should be defined in the referenced schema instead of the parent schema"), and the shape the existing `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` asserts must never ship.

Trigger: a typed `$ref` target containing a node that pairs `$ref` with a schema *keyword*. zod's reused-schema shape is exactly this — `{"format":"uuid","description":"tt","$ref":"#/$defs/S"}`. `format` is not in `untypedForKimi`'s notes list, so the node counts as untyped, and `keywordType` reads `format` as `string`, so the fix emits:

```text
{"type":"string","format":"uuid","description":"tt","$ref":"#/$defs/S"}
```

Pre-fix this node shipped untouched (its chain end still got typed via the outer walk), so this is a new regression vector, not a pre-existing quirk. It is latent in today's fixtures — Codex's `__schema14` sits as a top-level `$def` outside every typed target's subtree, which is why `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` still passes — but zod inlines single-use schemas, which puts exactly this node inside typed defs. The issue's acceptance list asks that the #3205 fix and this one protect each other ("do not add types to reference-chain intermediate nodes"); the inner walk currently breaks that invariant.

Suggested guard, for @skygunner to apply as they see fit — inside the inner walk, skip nodes carrying a `$ref`; nothing is lost, because the outer walk already visits those refs and types their chain ends:

```go
walkSchema(t, func(inner gjson.Result) {
    if inner.Get(`\$ref`).Type == gjson.String {
        return
    }
    ...
```

With that skip, the reported repro and every other case above still pass (union nodes like `y` carry no `$ref`).

Branch: skygunner/magpie `fix/3566-kimi-typed-ref-untyped-union` (head df5363d0a2333117f62f33f5a44088a027d9d716)

Not verified: no live Kimi account — the type-beside-`$ref` refusal is taken from #3205 and the repo's own RefChain assertion, not re-tested against the API; the real 198-tool REA toolset from the report was not available.

AI use: verification performed with AI assistance; all commands and outputs above were run and read locally.

Thanks @congee949 for the report and @skygunner for the fix branch.

@ggbdpq 的验证和指出的递归边界都对，分支已按它重写：[fix/3566-kimi-typed-ref-untyped-union](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3566-kimi-typed-ref-untyped-union) 重接到当前 `upstream/main`（`2df5d40ee`，保留 #3205 的引用链解析循环），head [`28919f45b`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/28919f45b30b0ad6a46aa251c83f6ccf9c4285a7)，旧 tip `df5363d0` 被覆盖。

你指出的边界是真实的回归向量，已按建议加守卫：内层 walk 跳过带 `$ref` 的节点——类型永不写在 `$ref` 旁边，这些 ref 的链端由外层 walk 补类型，什么都不损失。同时把缺的测试补上了：

- `TestKimiTypedRefTargetInnerUnion`：报告里的最小复现（typed `$ref` 目标内部的无类型 object oneOf 补 `"type":"object"`），加上你给的 zod 复用形状——`{"format":"uuid","description":"tt","$ref":"#/$defs/T"}` 在 typed 目标内逐字原样（类型不落在它旁边），链端 `T` 补上应有的类型。这个测试在未修的 clean main 上红（`y` 原样 `{"oneOf":[…]}`），修复后绿。
- `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` 及全部 `TestKimi*` 在 head 上绿；全量 `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/` 与 3619 那条一样，只有本环境 clean main 同红的五个基线失败，无其他。

（之前分支确实没带报告场景的测试，这次一并补上。）

- `TestKimiToolRefTypesRefChain` 及全部 `TestKimi*` 在 head 上绿；全量 `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/` 与 3619 那条一样，只有本环境 clean main 同红的五个基线失败，无其他。

（之前分支确实没带报告场景的测试，这次一并补上。）

issue.title: [Bug] gateway/Responses: Aliyun K3.1 Pro rejects recursive any-JSON tool schema

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Problem

Through Magpie's Responses gateway, an Aliyun OpenAI-compatible provider serving `kimi-k3.1-pro` rejects the tool declaration below with:

```text
400 InternalError.Algo: An error occurred in model serving, error message is: [Invalid request parameters.]
```

The request does not have to call this tool, and conversation history is not required to reproduce it. A single user message plus this tool is enough. The field is `tools[name=request_environment_input].parameters.properties.secrets.items.properties.target`.

The same request completes after replacing that field's `$ref` with `{}` and removing the now-unused `$defs`. `{}` accepts any JSON value, which is also the value domain described by the recursive definition.

This is not the untyped-object-union case in #3566: the referenced definition is an `anyOf` that recursively describes arbitrary JSON values.

## Minimal reproduction

POST through Magpie's `/v1/responses`, with the selected provider/model being the OpenAI-compatible Aliyun provider's `kimi-k3.1-pro`:

```json
{
  "model": "kimi-k3.1-pro",
  "stream": true,
  "store": false,
  "input": [{"type": "message", "role": "user", "content": [{"type": "input_text", "text": "Reply only OK."}]}],
  "tools": [{
    "type": "function",
    "name": "request_environment_input",
    "strict": false,
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "mode": {"type": "string", "enum": ["repositories", "name", "secrets", "network", "review"]},
        "secrets": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "name": {"type": "string"},
              "target": {"$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"}
            },
            "required": ["name"],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        }
      },
      "required": ["mode"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "$defs": {
        "__schema0": {
          "anyOf": [
            {"type": "string"},
            {"type": "number"},
            {"type": "boolean"},
            {"type": "null"},
            {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"}},
            {"type": "object", "properties": {}, "additionalProperties": {"$ref": "#/$defs/__schema0"}}
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  }]
}
```

To reproduce the working control, remove `parameters.$defs` and use this for the `target` property:

```json
"target": {}
```

## Evidence

Tested on 2026-11-06 (Asia/Taipei). The first A/B replay used Magpie 0.1.3127; the full-request fix verification used 0.1.3132.

| Change to the same request | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Original tool declaration, single user message | `response.failed`, 400 `Invalid request parameters` |
| Original declaration, full prior conversation history | Same 400 |
| Full history, delete all reasoning items | Same 400 |
| Full history, remove only this tool | `response.completed` |
| Full history, keep all 44 tools, replace only the recursive target schema with `{}` and remove unused `$defs` | `response.completed` |

The successful full-history control retained 330 input items, 6 reasoning items, and 10 function-call/result pairs. This rules out conversation history or reasoning replay as the trigger in this reproduction.

## Source pointer

On the current `main` checked on 2026-11-07, `191f3c0af1934fbbec87dc589fddf26913699aa9`:

- `kimiToolRefTypes` skips an `anyOf` `$ref` target in `untypedForKimi`, as the comment notes that adding `type` beside `anyOf` is also rejected.
- `isKimi` recognizes Moonshot/Kimi hosts and presets. The tested provider is a custom OpenAI-compatible Aliyun provider, so this vendor endpoint does not appear to enter that transformation. I have not tested Kimi/Moonshot's official endpoint.

A narrowly scoped local `onProvider` middleware that performs the verified recursive-any-JSON-to-`{}` conversion works as a workaround. It leaves other providers, protocols, and differently constrained schemas unchanged.

Please decide whether this belongs in the Kimi schema normalization, a narrowly scoped Aliyun/K3.1 Responses compatibility transform, or should be addressed by the provider.

Related: #3566.

This report contains only a minimized tool schema and test outcomes; no credentials, private conversation contents, or local file paths are included.
